findings.reader: A tight, well-proportioned dated news piece: it reports the September 15 pledge accurately, explains through one honest hypothetical why translated clarity is not local usefulness, retains criticism and the AP funder disclosure, and closes with genuinely specific verification questions. Both explain-back and a new flood-chatbot transfer scenario are fully supported by the article's mechanism. No failure families present; all outcomes pass.
findings.facts: All six material claims check out against the captured AP article and Goalkeepers report: the $1B/two-year pledge, the language and local-context rationale, the support-not-replacement goal, the Shaffer criticism, the pilots caveat, and the AP funder disclosure are each accurate, attributed and appropriately hedged. Dating and uncertainty handling are sound.
